source_bindings_scope: inspected-baseline-only; historical design inputs, not moving qualification

policy.observed_pause: irreversibly end the local session instance before another application packet, command, move or simulation update
policy.loss_or_linked_termination: seal local session, abandon foreground and exit without ownership restoration
policy.paused_acknowledgement: local input/render release only; no socket-close, remote-delivery, result or durability proof
policy.clock_boundary: host settles through Game result path at latched monotonic terminal observation timestamp; clients preserve confirmed state and uncertainty
policy.transport_cleanup: audit actual local close semantics; no round-trip/flush/save prerequisite for local release; pending cleanup must complete before fresh connection
policy.resume: ended readonly UI only after successful input reacquisition; no old-session resume, automatic reconnect or offline continuation
policy.new_session: explicit user action, completed old teardown and fresh instance identity
policy.persistence: retain RAM/last successful save; separate deferred non-resumable diagnostics with confirmed-or-unresolved result authority; no hidden-write guarantee
policy.wire_protocol: unchanged by this design; no terminal-result delivery or agreement inferred
policy.shared_runtime_elapsed: truthful monotonic time; no global reset/clamp or offline simulation-discard policy applied to LAN liveness

open_prerequisites.requirement: Choose and test per-app monotonic service-gap limits before buffered work admission and enablement; no arbitrary shared timeout.
Specify silent-host and stale-authority behavior; existing pairing/pending-move timers are not an active-play heartbeat. Version/review any wire extension.
Add non-resetting terminal state/transport cleanup with honest host/connected predicates and readonly retained views.

implementation_increments.deliverable: Chess terminal/controller primitives, role-aware clocks and interruption state; settle service-gap/stale-authority policy.
Chess production loop and optional native adapter, real peers and post-poll ownership fixtures.
Independent Sandline terminal transport/world policy, service-gap limit and actual loop/peer checks.
Independent Beacon terminal Session policy, service-gap limit and actual loop/peer checks.
Exact-artifact qualification and reviewed per-app enablement; physical phase pending.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Pause or shell loss while connecting, listening or pairing
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Seal pending attempt without inventing a match or accepted player slot.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Host versus client pauses during active Chess/Sandline/Beacon play
future_acceptance_cases.expected: End local session; distinguish host termination from one departing client and label remote state unconfirmed.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Pause arrives during input or network polling
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Drain control and seal admission before any subsequent packet, move, simulation update or frame.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Queued REQ/PLY/SYNC/END, movement, firing or snapshot races terminal intent
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject old application work after the terminal observation boundary; do not infer fresh authority from backlog.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Host clock expires at or before terminal observation with a move queued
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Settle through Game result path at the latched timestamp; expiry wins over the move.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: An authoritative result already exists before interruption
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Preserve the result and distinguish it from the local interruption reason.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Client interruption with a sent move awaiting host confirmation
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Retain confirmed board/history and request uncertainty; no invented accepted move or winner.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Slow/failed diagnostic or PGN output, hidden loss or termination
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Release local ownership without filesystem prerequisite; preserve last successful file and show foreground failures.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Moving/firing/pulsing world ends and the UI later resumes
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Preserve readonly last-local/host-confirmed world without reset, simulation catch-up or conversion to offline authority.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Repeated pause, resume, redraw, loss and failed resume
future_acceptance_cases.expected: No session resurrection, stale input or old foreground restoration; failed reopening remains closed.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Shell output is full or unknown packets fill a receive batch
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Retain nonblocking local acknowledgement semantics; drain control before app work without network/disk wait.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Local close or notification is delayed/lost; process stops before transport cleanup
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Local terminal state stays sealed; remote delivery/result and teardown deadline remain unconfirmed.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Unobserved stop, queued packets, uint32 clock wrap or longer gap
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Use reviewed per-app uint64 gap/stale-authority policy before admission; do not reset liveness or claim universal stop detection.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Hidden EOF, SIGTERM, exception or failed construction after another owner draws
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Abandon without old saved-frame restoration, input reopening or hidden report output.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: User explicitly starts a fresh match after resuming the ended view
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Require completed old teardown and fresh session identity; no reused commands, peers, requests or automatic reconnect.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: One ENet client leaves while host and other clients remain
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Ordinary host cleanup preserves remaining players and fresh slot reuse; local view is not a shared final score.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Default M5/unlinked LAN and ordinary older peers
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Retain existing behavior and wire compatibility; any future heartbeat/protocol extension needs separate version/capability review.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Exact new per-app package and pinned Gh0st build on an identified spare target
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Qualify M5 launch/input/exit first, then advertised linked scenarios and responsiveness without promoting software fixtures to device evidence.

existing_offline_tests: Historical offline pilot and ordinary network tests do not establish the proposed LAN lifecycle behavior.
unchanged_gates: Video D5 live/device qualification and idle optimization
retained baseline/control and exact-artifact release promotion
upstream_update_boundary: Official M5 updates remain reviewed inputs to new Zero candidates. Stock-image refresh does not automatically refresh Zero locks or authorize an in-place base update.
